content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Application Fee
content_sections.text: The cost of application form is paid to The Director, IGIMS, Patna, in the form of Demand Draft.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed Performa with requisite fee and copies of all supportive documents. Original certificates including original certificates/document, as proof of age, Qualifications, Reservation, Caste etc. No Objection Certificate issued by the employer, at the time of Interview (for candidates employed in government / Semi Government Department or any other employer).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on bio-data and interview. The scheme of marking for such ad-hoc appointments is out of 100 marks: MBBS (10 marks, -2 for each failure), MS/MD/DNB (10 marks, -5 for each failure), Additional qualification (10 marks), Publication (10 marks, 2 each for Pub Med for maximum of 6 marks, 2 each for other than Pub Med for maximum of 4 marks), Poster/Presentation (10 marks, 2 mark each for maximum of 10), Academic Award (10 marks, 2 mark each for maximum of 10), Specialized training (10 marks, 3 months training: 5 marks, 6 months training: 10 marks), Project (extra intramural) (10 marks), and Subject Knowledge (20 marks). The minimum qualifying criteria for appointment is UR - 50th Percentile, BC/EBC/EWS - 45th Percentile, and SC/ST - 40th Percentile.

faq.question: Q1. When is the IGIMS Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28 October 2026, with reporting up to 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the HOD, Surgical Gastroenterology, Chamber, IGIMS, Patna- 14.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for IGIMS Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies under the 89 days residency programme.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have MS/DNB in General Surgery, a medical qualification included in schedule I & II of MCI, an MCI recognized PG qualification, and registration with Central/State Medical council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 28 October 2026, with relaxations for reserved categories as per state rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UR/BC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for UR/EWS/BC/EBC candidates is Rs. 1000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST candidates is Rs. 250/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is private practice allowed for Senior Residents at IGIMS?
faq.answer: No, private practice of kind, direct or indirect, including laboratory is strictly prohibited.

faq.question: Q9. Is stay in the campus compulsory?
faq.answer: Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided; if not provided, HRA is admissible as per rule.

faq.question: Q10. Are reservation benefits available to candidates outside Bihar?
faq.answer: No, reservation benefits are applicable to Bihar State domicile candidates only.
